#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

long long solve(long long n, long long m) {
    long long min = std::min(n, m);
    long long max = std::max(n, m);

    if (min == 1) {
        return max / 6 * 6 + 2 * std::max(0LL, max % 6 - 3);
    }

    if (min == 2 && (max == 2 || max == 3 || max == 7)) {
        if (max == 2) return 0;
        if (max == 3) return 4;
        return 12;
    }

    if (min == 3 && max == 3) {
        return 8;
    }

    long long ans = min * max;
    if (max & 1LL) {
        ans -= ans % 2;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    int n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    std::cout << solve(n, m) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
